import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    a=p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]/T
    amp=p[4]/T+p[8]*T
    rate=p[5]+p[6]*T
    return a+amp*eps*np.exp(-rate*eps)+p[7]*eps+p[9]*eps**2/T
